            best_num = num1;
            best_den = den1;

#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    long long x, y, n;
    scanf("%lld%lld%lld", &x, &y, &n);
    
    if (y <= n) {
        long long g = __gcd(x, y);
        printf("%lld/%lld", x / g, y / g);
        return 0;
    }
    
    auto compare_fractions = [&](long long a1, long long b1, long long a2, long long b2) -> bool {
        return abs(a1 * y - b1 * x) * b2 < abs(a2 * y - b2 * x) * b1;
    };
    
    long long num = 0, den = 1;
    
    for (long long i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
        long long j = (i * x + y / 2) / y;
        if (j > i * x / y) j--;
        
        if (compare_fractions(j, i, num, den)) {
            num = j;
            den = i;
        }
        if (compare_fractions(j + 1, i, num, den)) {
            num = j + 1;
            den = i;
        }
    }
    
    printf("%lld/%lld", num, den);
    return 0;
}
